description:
Sarsabz proudly presents #SalamKissan – A step aimed at recognizing the tireless efforts by the Pakistani farmer, who works day & night to ensure that we, the consumers, never have an empty plate. The farmers effort is largely ignored, and we take for granted their contribution in our everyday life; unseen, they work in harsh weather, sun, rain & cold and grow the delicate plants that glean the produce we eat daily, and through this initiative, #Sarsabz aims to recognize and appreciate all that these unbelievably hardworking individuals do for us. #SarsabzPakistan

Celebrating Kissan Day in Pakistan on 18th December, 2019. 
 
Music Production: Ali Noor
Female Vocals: Mehak
Composition: Ahsan Pervaiz
Video Direction: Jami Moor
